title: Bus task smoke test
body: Verify task-add, task-list, task-update, and status work for the master threadmaster bus.

title: Phase 3B: gateway-backed AppForge source of truth
body: LANE LOCK: ArgentAIOS/argentos-core /Users/sem/code/argent-core target dev. Next AppForge task: wire the AppForge desktop fully to gateway-backed base/table/record read-write source of truth. Do not rely on metadata/local fallback except as explicit migration fallback. Allowed scope: AppForge dashboard components/hooks plus AppForge gateway/store/schema files only if needed and declared in coordination board. Required output: merge packet with exact file list, truth labels for real vs preview panels, tests for create/read/update/delete round trip, and note any workflow event implications. Do not touch Workflow UI internals.

title: Production-smoke workflow destination connectors
body: Use the AOS readiness index to choose a small workflow-critical smoke subset: Telegram/Discord/Slack/Resend or email, n8n/Zapier webhook bridge, and one CRM/project connector if keys exist. Goal: prove which connector output destinations can be safely shown in Workflows as live-ready. If operator keys are missing, post exact service-key variable names and commands needed. Do not add new connector features until the smoke truth table is posted.

title: Workflow blocker sweep from stub/readiness data
body: Run a focused AOU sweep for anything that affects end-to-end Workflows usability: output destinations, connector manifests, channel surfacing, skill/tool discovery, install packaging, and fake/scaffold claims. Deliver a top-10 blocker list with owner lane, resolution options, and recommended owner. Do not edit shared runtime; this is discovery/report unless a trivial docs/status fix is isolated.

title: OpenClaw current-dev smoke and voice next-step proof
body: Rerun the browser/OpenClaw smoke from current dev after the latest status/tabs JSON fixes. If browser smoke passes, proceed to the next additive realtime voice slice under the existing voice-call/OpenClaw scope with fake-provider tests first. If it fails, post exact command, output, and minimum file list. Do not touch Workflows or shared gateway/browser files until the smoke result is posted and ownership is explicit.

title: Workflow operator slice 2: output polish and browser smoke
body: Build on codex/workflows-usability-day. Finish OutputForm section polish while preserving connector-action destinations, then browser-smoke 5 owner-operator templates: Daily Marketing Brief, VIP Email Alert, Client Onboarding, Operations Cleanup, Newsletter Builder. Acceptance: import, binding nudge, validate, run fixture, run history visible. Post blockers with owner + resolution options.
